text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. They improve over time by recognizing patterns. Deep learning is an advanced form of machine learning that uses complex networks, similar to the human brain, to handle very large amounts of information. You probably use AI every day without noticing. It helps recommend movies on streaming services, filters spam from your email, powers voice assistants like Siri or Alexa, and even suggests routes on navigation apps. While AI can seem futuristic, it is already a practical part of modern life, making many tasks faster and easier.
